name: filter
title: Filter
description: Keep array items that satisfy a predicate. With `where` (formula with `it` bound), keeps elements where the formula is truthy. With `by` (dotted path), inspects that field; with `equals`, matches value. `where` and `by`/`equals` are mutually exclusive.
